_description: Cross-record registry of unknown FIT message types, keyed by manufacturer. Tracks what each proprietary message type number means, based on accumulated evidence across analysed files. Update this file alongside writing a new record whenever a message type is confirmed or a hypothesis is formed.

unknown_13.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (documented). Single occurrence per file — session-level training configuration block.

unknown_22.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Count of 6 in record-001 (Fenix 7) may reflect paired devices/sensors; count of 1 in record-002 (FR35, no external HRM).

unknown_79.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file — likely a session-level user physiological snapshot.

unknown_104.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Count of 9 matches lap count in record-001 (Fenix 7). Count of 7 in record-002 (FR35) does not match lap count (4); interpretation may be more complex.

unknown_113.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). 3 occurrences in record-001 (Fenix 7); 2 occurrences in record-002 (FR35). Consistent with personal best tracking segments across devices.

unknown_140.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file — session-level activity metrics summary. Present on both Fenix 7 and FR35, confirming it is not a high-end device feature.

unknown_141.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). EPO = Extended Prediction Orbit (satellite data for faster GPS acquisition). Single occurrence per file.

unknown_147.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file — sensor configuration block.

unknown_216.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Note: unrelated to session field def_num 216 (ending_body_battery) — message type number and field def_num are different namespaces. Count of 20 likely reflects one message per HR zone (or zone x metric combination).

unknown_233.hypothesis: Count exactly matches record message count (2923) — one per second alongside each record message. Likely a parallel per-second proprietary data stream; strong candidate for running dynamics or raw sensor data from the chest strap or accelerometer
unknown_233.notes: Count matches gps_metadata count exactly in both observed files (2923:2923 in -001; 2390:2390 in -workout-001). Paired per GPS point, not per record. Neither fitparse nor FFV identifies this message type. Purpose unknown.

unknown_288.hypothesis: Count is 2 in -001 (non-workout run) and 3 in -workout-001. Original bookend hypothesis no longer fits cleanly. Purpose unknown. FFV does not identify.

unknown_312.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). 10 occurrences in record-001 — likely one per km/mile auto-split plus a partial final split.

unknown_313.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Paired with unknown_312 (split) as expected — aggregated summary across split types.

unknown_325.hypothesis: 336 occurrences — sub-minute frequency suggests a periodic metric; possible candidates: HRV intervals, respiration snapshots, or stress measurements
unknown_325.notes: FFV does not identify. Sub-minute frequency in both files. Purpose unknown.

unknown_326.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). 49 occurrences in a ~49-minute run — prior hypothesis of once-per-minute was correct on count but wrong on identity. GPS event log, possibly satellite fix quality or position event records.

unknown_327.hypothesis: Count exactly matches workout_step count in -workout-001 (5:5). In -001 (no structured workout), count was 5 — a coincidence or consistent behaviour. Possible workout_step supplementary data; FFV does not identify.

unknown_394.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). CPE likely refers to Course Point or Computed Position Error. Single occurrence per file.

unknown_499.hypothesis: Single occurrence — high message number suggests a newer Garmin firmware feature; unknown
unknown_499.notes: FFV does not identify. Single occurrence in both files.
